cause_quote: The introducing diff added `result.scratch = await cleanScratch({` inside the existing maintenance job, so automatic scratch reclaim inherited the job's one-hour startup delay.
user_saw: Expired scratch clones stayed on disk when the Gateway restarted more often than once an hour.
summary: The fix schedules the first worktree maintenance pass as soon as the post-ready startup barrier admits it and keeps later passes hourly.
reasoning: Scratch expiry shipped in #193677 inside the existing hourly worktree maintenance job, whose first scheduled run was already delayed by a full interval. The path history confirms that the initial delay stayed in place until this fix, so frequent restarts could postpone automatic reclaim from the day scratch expiry shipped.
